title: Analysis: Super El Niño Could Drive Up Global Food Prices
detail: A new analysis assesses how the 2026 Super El Niño could affect the global economy and drive up food prices, examining broader macroeconomic and agricultural implications. The event is expected to disrupt agricultural output across key producing regions, potentially triggering inflationary pressure on staple commodities.
